description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). It involves regulatory matters - specifically the issuance of Certificates of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it concerns statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
